title: TIC quarterly U.S. gross external debt (as-of 2026-06-30) — an ordinary edition, and the first live test that only June revises
source: EST: home.treasury.gov/data/treasury-international-capital-tic-system/release-dates-of-tic-data, fetched direct 2026-09-09 (plain curl, HTTP 200, 111,181 bytes) by the tic-quarterly-external-debt-2027-06-30 initial-research adjacency sweep — its 2026 table's September row reads '30' in the column headed 'Quarterly: U.S. gross external debt at end of previous quarter'. The same page's notes give the rule: 'The release dates are the last business day of each quarter (March, June, September, and December)'. Corroborated mechanically: 2026-09-30 is a Wednesday and the last business day of September 2026, offset +0 from the page's own rule, which reproduces 55 of 65 dated publications 2011-2026 at +0. Filed estimate per this lane's no-self-confirm limit on an event discovered in-sweep. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: DISCOVERED during the tic-quarterly-external-debt-2027-06-30 initial research (2026-09-09). Proposed because it is the nearest live observation of a series whose central finding needs testing outside the archive: 66 of 66 archived revisions to a previously published quarter carry a June release stamp, and none carries a March, September or December one. This release is 21 days out and is the first of three chances before 2027-06-30 to watch a NON-June edition publish and revise nothing (the others are 2026-12-31 and 2027-03-31). It publishes the as-of 2026-06-30 position; the last first-vintage headline was $30.197tn as-of 2026-03-31 (published 2026-06-30, read from ticdata.treasury.gov/…/debta2026q1.html). Impact LOW and symbols empty on the standing grounds: 16:00 ET is after the equity cash close, the data is a quarter stale, no house playbook is macro-keyed. NOTE THE CORRIDOR: 2026-09-30 already carries a `high` government-funding deadline and a `high` PCE print, so this entry adds a schedule observation, not a tradeable one — and the funding deadline is itself the mechanism behind the series' worst historical slip (2018Q3's release landed 2019-01-31, +31 days, during the 35-day lapse). Proposed as an estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
